# shopify_checkout_and_accounts_configuration (List Resource)

Lists every checkout and accounts configuration, published or not, with its live branding (write-only paths left out). The published one's display name ends in ` (published)`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "shopify_checkout_and_accounts_configuration" "all" {
  provider = shopify
}
```
